title: 30 ## Violent Crimes 1.9.1 2,32,554 Violent crimes constituting 14.3 per cent of the total IPC crimes were reported during 1993. Compared to the previous year, 1992, such crimes recorded a decline of 7.7 per cent. The share of these crimes towards total IPC crimes during the last four decades increased substantially from 8.2 per cent in 1953 to 14.3 per cent in 1993. On the other hand, the rate of such crimes compared to the previous year decreased from 29.0 in 1992 to 26.3 in this year, except for 'Rape' where it slightly rose from 1.3 to 1.4 during the same period. Such crimes recorded an increase of 22.0 per cent during the decade 1983-93.
